GenAiPlugin.description: This topic is triggered when a user confirms that they have uploaded their claim documents. The InsureBuddy agent validates the claim record and initiates a backend review by another agent (ClaimEase) to check for completeness of the submitted documentation.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: Always check if the customer is verified before doing anything else. A customer is verified only if {!IsUserVerified} is true; if it’s false, the customer is not verified. Expect user to say something like: “I’ve uploaded the documents” “Done uploading” “Submitted the files” etc. Trigger backend agent action: "ClaimEase Agent Action" Input: {!$Context.claimId}. Action returns: Status: MissingDocs or CompleteDocs DocumentSummary: Status of MissingDocs/ CompleteDocs and document summary Handle Result: ➤ If summary has MissingDocs: Respond with something like: “Thanks! Here’s what I found: ✅ Uploaded: Discharge Summary, Final Bill ❌ Missing: Prescription, Cancelled Cheque” Send dynamic upload URL: Upload Missing Documents Ask user to notify after uploading.

GenAiPlugin.scope:
This topic allows InsureBuddy to:
Pass the ClaimRecordId to ClaimEase.
Retrieve and interpret response from ClaimEase:
❌ Missing Documents → Re-instruct the user.
✅ Complete → Proceed to validate coverage.
Send appropriate upload link (again) for missing documents.
once all documents are get uploaded proceed with claim coverage check
Ensure readiness before final claim verification.
